    Profile

    Zangetsu is a descendant from Wadatsumi, trained in the ancient practices. In his left hand, he wields Izanami, governor of destruction, while in his right hand, he wields Izanagi, governor of creation. Through his combat style, based on the ancient practices, he gives both the impression of a dancer and a Godly warrior.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
    Height: 180cm
    Weight: 70kg
    Birthday: Apr 12
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: Rice balls
    Hobbies: Cooking
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 羽多野渉
